text: Job Description Nvidia is seeking highly motivated and innovative interns that are interested in pursuing a career in developing autonomous vehicles. Interns will work alongside full time engineers in solving issues in real driving scenarios and developing proof of concept advanced techniques that keeps Nvidia as a market leader in autonomous vehicle performance. An intern will work closely with software engineers to design, develop, and debug many functional aspects of our autonomous development stack. The candidate will be heavily involved with early modeling and simulation required to produce our world-class products, and will follow the algorithms all the way through the development process for autonomous vehicle products. \LETSITH NG ] TS « Craft perception software for Autonomous Vehicle products « Work as part of software engineering development teams and make immediate impact to production « Work with focus on sensor fusion and radar perception tracking modules « Design, implement, test, and maintain system tools for product development and product verification « Software Performance/latency optimization What we need to see: * Pursuing BS or MS degree in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or related degree « Exceptional programming skills in C++ and Python. « Familiarity with computer system architectures and the hardware/software interface layer models « Knowledge in tracking algorithms and optimal estimation Ways to stand out from the crowd: « Interest in low-level operating system knowledge, specifically memory/resource management, scheduling and process control, and hardware virtualization « Experience with complex system-level debugging With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology industry's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us and our product lines are growing fast in some of the hottest fields such as virtual reality, deep learning, artificial intelligence, graphics virtualization, photo realistic rendering and more.
